page.layout: One page of running text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: reducuntur ad primam figuram ex minore negativa.

Quatuor autem modò dicti modi ad duos commodè revocari possunt, nempe ad eum qui fit à positione consequentis ad positionem antecedentis: & ad eū qui fit à destructione antecedentis ad destructionem consequentis: Quia conversa per contrapositionem seu ἀντιστροφὴν[?] negata æquipollet suæ directæ affirmatæ: ut, hæc hypothesis: Si non est animal, non est homo, æquipollet huic universali affirmatæ: Omnis homo est animal. Eandem enim habent sensum: autore etiam Zabarella. Itaque hæc proitilla[?] sumi intelligi potest.
In disiuncto: cùm fit sophistico lusu, Vel à positione primi ad positionem secundi.
Vel à positione secundi ad positionem primi.
main_text.head: Exempla paralogismi, ubi figura prorsus nulla propter 4. vel 5. terminos.
main_text.p: Magistratus debet gladio punire scelera-tos. Petrus est Apostolus: Ergo Petrus debet punire gladio sceleratos. Vel: Ergo Petrus debet excommunicare sceleratos.

page.notes: Page number "81" is printed in old style; the final digit may be an r-like 1, read as 81 with doubt. Some Greek (ἀντιστροφὴν) and the word after "hæc" (proitilla) are not certain. "eū" reads as eum with a tilde over u. The "F" at the foot and "Nego" at the right are read as signature and catchword. The paragraph beginning "Vel à positione secundi" is indented and taken as a separate paragraph.
